analogy.rationale: Potassium channel activators target KCNQ/KCNMA/KCNN and related channels that are poorly expressed in these cell lines, so transcriptional responses should be weak; the closest reference classes are other ion-channel modulators (potassium channel blocker, calcium channel activator, ATP channel blocker) that act on overlapping channel families or membrane excitability programs.
